name: deep-claim
description: Deep Claim: an asteroid-mining platformer in Godot 4 for the web. Collect rare earths, precious metals and building materials on oxygen and jetpack fuel, then drive the buggy out before the shaft caves in.

scripts.test:godot: godot --headless --path godot --import && godot --headless --path godot -s tests/test_levels.gd && godot --headless --path godot -s tests/test_deaths.gd && godot --headless --path godot -s tests/test_flow.gd
scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run test:godot && npm run build && wrangler deploy
